title: Kammler negotiating with the Western Allies
summary: Nick Cook tells of Kammler negotiating with the Western Allies, about 1945 at Europe, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There was quite a bit of evidence that Kammler had been in negotiations with the Allied Western Allies before the end of the war.

plain: An aviation journalist named Nick Cook, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about Hans Kammler, a senior Nazi SS officer in charge of Germany's secret weapons projects. Cook says there was quite a bit of evidence that Kammler had been negotiating with the Western Allies, meaning the Americans and British, before the war ended in 1945. If true, it would mean Nazi secret technology, and perhaps Kammler himself, may have quietly passed into Allied hands.
